operations.reasoning: Workflow & Approvals module review: Functionality observed: (1) Dashboard provides module entry points and summary/overview navigation. (2) Workflow Designer / Workflow Definitions manages approval workflow definitions, including workflow names, target modules, status, and design actions. (3) Approval Templates provides reusable approval patterns/templates with node counts and actions such as Use Template. (4) Approval Requests lists submitted approval requests tied to modules/workflows and acts as the intake stage before approver worklists. (5) Pending Approvals is the active approver queue for outstanding actions. (6) Approval History records completed approval requests with reference number, title, workflow, status, submitted timestamp, and completed timestamp. Relations between modules: workflow definitions are the core configuration; templates reuse or package workflow structures; requests instantiate a workflow/template for a business record; pending approvals represents in-flight approver tasks generated from submitted requests; approval history is the terminal state after approval/rejection/cancellation; dashboard links and summarizes the overall area. Flagged vulnerabilities / issues: no obvious security exploit was directly exposed in the visited UI, but there are notable quality/debug risks: navigation clicks sometimes reported weak targeting/no focused element, suggesting flaky UI interaction behavior; Pending Approvals showed an empty-state queue (No approval actions), which may indicate missing seed data, broken routing into approver inboxes, or a workflow handoff gap; several areas rely heavily on list views without obvious validation/audit cues on-screen, so authorization, audit logging, and state-transition controls should be verified further; completed history currently shows approved items only in the sampled view, so rejection/cancellation paths and access control should be tested separately. Overall assessment: the module structure is coherent and the request lifecycle from design/template to request, pending worklist, and history is visible, but the project needs additional verification around inbox population, permissions, and state-transition robustness.
